title: Rule 06 — nicht vs. kein
short: Use nicht to negate an action or idea; use kein with many nouns.
syntax:
Ich verstehe das nicht.
Ich habe keine Zeit.
body: The word nicht can move depending on what is being negated. In this minimum system, learn reliable sentences first. Kein behaves like an article and changes form with the noun.
examples: I do not have an appointment.
pitfall: “Ich muss nicht kommen” means “I do not have to come”; “Ich darf nicht kommen” means “I am not allowed to come”.
